title: Google\Cloud\Container\V1\NodePool\UpgradeSettings
name: UpgradeSettings
description: These upgrade settings control the level of parallelism and the level of disruption caused by an upgrade.

params.name: data
params.description: Optional. Data for populating the Message object.

params.name: data.max_surge
params.description: The maximum number of nodes that can be created beyond the current size of the node pool during the upgrade process.

params.name: data.max_unavailable
params.description: The maximum number of nodes that can be simultaneously unavailable during the upgrade process. A node is considered available if its status is Ready.

methods.name: getMaxSurge
methods.description: The maximum number of nodes that can be created beyond the current size of the node pool during the upgrade process.

methods.name: setMaxSurge
methods.description: The maximum number of nodes that can be created beyond the current size of the node pool during the upgrade process.

methods.name: getMaxUnavailable
methods.description: The maximum number of nodes that can be simultaneously unavailable during the upgrade process. A node is considered available if its status is Ready.

methods.name: setMaxUnavailable
methods.description: The maximum number of nodes that can be simultaneously unavailable during the upgrade process. A node is considered available if its status is Ready.
